text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah:
"Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak with them. Bring them to the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and offer them wine to drink."
So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, along with his brothers and all his sons—the whole house of the Rechabites—

and I brought them to the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, the man of God. It was next to the chamber of the officials, above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.
Then I set before the members of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine and cups, and I said to them, "Drink some wine."
But they answered, "We drink no wine, for Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, commanded us: 'You and your children are never to drink wine.
You are not to build houses, or sow seed, or plant vineyards, or own them. Instead, you are to live in tents all your days, so that you may live long in the land where you are sojourning.'
We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, in everything he commanded us: to drink no wine all our days—neither we, nor our wives, nor our sons and daughters.

versions.text: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, in everything he commanded us. We drink no wine, all our days—neither we, nor our wives, nor our sons and daughters.
versions.explanation: In Hebrew the infinitive clause 'not to drink wine' explains what they obeyed; breaking it into a separate sentence with an intrusive comma ('We drink no wine, all our days') interrupts the flow for oral reading.

text: We build no houses to live in, and we have no vineyard or field or seed.

versions.text: We build no houses to live in, and we own no vineyard, field, or seed.
versions.explanation: 'Own... seed' is an odd collocation in English; the Hebrew idiom is simply 'we have no vineyard or field or seed,' which also reads more smoothly aloud.

text: We have lived in tents, obeying and doing everything our father Jonadab commanded us.

But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, we said, 'Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape the army of the Chaldeans and the army of the Arameans.' So we have been living in Jerusalem."
Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
"This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and say to the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not accept correction and listen to my words? declares the LORD.

The command of Jonadab son of Rechab, who ordered his sons not to drink wine, has been carried out. To this day they have drunk none, because they obeyed their father's command. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you have not listened to me.

Again and again I sent you all my servants the prophets, saying, 'Turn now, each of you, from your evil way; mend your deeds and do not follow other gods to serve them, and dwell in the land I gave to you and your fathers.' But you would not incline your ear or listen to me.

versions.text: Again and again I sent you all my servants the prophets, saying, 'Turn now, each of you, from your evil way; mend your deeds and do not follow other gods to serve them. Then you will remain in the land I gave to you and your fathers.' But you would not incline your ear or listen to me.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew שְׁבוּ is an imperative continuing the series of commands ('and dwell in the land'), not a promise of result. Rendering it as 'Then you will remain' turns a command into a consequence and loses the parallel structure of the prophetic appeal.

text: The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab have kept the command their father gave them, but this people has not listened to me.

Therefore this is what the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am about to bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem every disaster I have pronounced against them, because I spoke to them and they did not listen; I called to them and they did not answer."

Then Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father and have kept all his precepts, doing everything he commanded you,
therefore this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Jonadab son of Rechab will never lack a descendant to stand before me."
